# Office.net
> Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 portal for signing in, installing apps, accessing productivity tools, and managing subscriptions.

Office.net serves as the web entry point for Microsoft 365 experiences, including Office apps, account access, setup flows, support resources, and links to product documentation across Microsoft domains.

## Portal and Sign-in
- [Office Home](https://www.office.net/): Main landing page for accessing Microsoft 365 apps, files, and account entry points.
- [Sign In](https://www.office.com/login): Microsoft 365 sign-in page for work, school, and personal accounts.
- [My Account](https://myaccount.microsoft.com/): Account portal for subscriptions, devices, privacy, and Microsoft service settings.
- [Microsoft 365 Home](https://www.microsoft365.com/): Central Microsoft 365 web portal for apps, documents, and collaboration tools.
- [Install Microsoft 365](https://www.office.com/myaccount): Account page for installs, subscriptions, and Office app management.

## Office Applications
- [Word](https://www.microsoft365.com/launch/word): Launch Microsoft Word on the web for document creation and editing.
- [Excel](https://www.microsoft365.com/launch/excel): Launch Microsoft Excel on the web for spreadsheets and analysis.
- [PowerPoint](https://www.microsoft365.com/launch/powerpoint): Launch Microsoft PowerPoint on the web for presentations and slides.
- [OneNote](https://www.microsoft365.com/launch/onenote): Launch OneNote on the web for notes and notebook organization.
- [Outlook](https://www.microsoft365.com/launch/outlook): Launch Outlook on the web for email, calendar, and contacts.
- [Teams](https://www.microsoft365.com/launch/teams): Launch Microsoft Teams for chat, meetings, and collaboration.

## Setup and Installation Help
- [Download and Install or Reinstall Microsoft 365 or Office 2021](https://support.microsoft.com/office/download-and-install-or-reinstall-microsoft-365-or-office-2021-on-a-pc-or-mac-4414eaaf-0478-48be-9c42-23adc4716658): Official installation instructions for Microsoft 365 and Office on PC or Mac.
- [Set Up Microsoft 365 for Business](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/setup/setup): Admin setup guidance for new Microsoft 365 business tenants.
- [Install Microsoft 365 Apps for Business](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/setup/install-applications): Admin documentation for deploying Microsoft 365 apps to users.
- [Activate Office](https://support.microsoft.com/office/activate-office-c39005d4-95ee-b91e-b399-2820fda32227): Support article for activating Office with a Microsoft account or product key.
- [Redeem a Product Key](https://setup.office.com/): Product key redemption portal for Office setup and activation.

## Microsoft 365 Admin
- [Microsoft 365 Admin Center](https://admin.microsoft.com/): Administrative portal for managing users, licenses, billing, and services.
- [Microsoft 365 Admin Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/): Core documentation for Microsoft 365 administration and tenant management.
- [Microsoft 365 Setup](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/setup/): Setup documentation for domains, users, apps, and tenant configuration.
- [Users and Groups](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/add-users/): Guidance for adding users, assigning licenses, and managing groups.
- [Billing and Subscriptions](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/billing/): Documentation for billing, invoices, subscriptions, and payment management.
- [Service Health and Message Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/view-service-health): Guidance for monitoring service health and organizational notices.

## End-User Help and Training
- [Microsoft 365 Support](https://support.microsoft.com/microsoft-365): Product support hub for Microsoft 365 apps, setup, and troubleshooting.
- [Office Support](https://support.microsoft.com/office): Support hub for Office apps, account help, and common tasks.
- [Microsoft 365 Training](https://support.microsoft.com/training): Training resources for Microsoft 365 apps and workflows.
- [Microsoft 365 Help Center](https://support.microsoft.com/): General Microsoft support portal for products, services, and troubleshooting.
- [Office Quick Start Guides](https://support.microsoft.com/office/office-quick-start-guides-25f909da-3e76-443d-94f4-6cdf7dedc51e): Quick-start resources for learning core Office applications.
- [Accessibility Support](https://support.microsoft.com/accessibility): Accessibility help and inclusive productivity guidance for Microsoft products.

## Developer and API Resources
- [Microsoft 365 Developer Center](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/): Entry point for building apps and integrations for Microsoft 365.
- [Microsoft Graph Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/): API documentation for accessing Microsoft 365 data and services.
- [Microsoft Graph REST API Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/overview): Reference for Microsoft Graph endpoints, resources, and operations.
- [Microsoft Graph SDKs](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/sdks/sdks-overview): SDK guidance for calling Microsoft Graph from multiple languages.
- [Office Add-ins Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/office/dev/add-ins/): Documentation for building Office add-ins across Office applications.
- [Microsoft 365 Platform Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/): Technical documentation for Microsoft 365 services, apps, and platform capabilities.

## Deployment and Enterprise Management
- [Microsoft 365 Apps Admin Center](https://config.office.com/): Portal for servicing profiles, inventory, and Microsoft 365 Apps management.
- [Microsoft 365 Apps Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployoffice/): Deployment documentation for Microsoft 365 Apps in organizations.
- [Office Deployment Tool Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployoffice/overview-office-deployment-tool): Overview of the Office Deployment Tool for enterprise installations.
- [Update Channels for Microsoft 365 Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployoffice/updates/overview-update-channels): Guidance on selecting and managing update channels.
- [Configuration Options for the Office Deployment Tool](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployoffice/office-deployment-tool-configuration-options): Reference for XML configuration settings used in Office deployments.
- [Microsoft 365 Apps Servicing](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployoffice/updates/overview-update-process-microsoft-365-apps): Documentation on update processes and servicing behavior.

## Security and Compliance
- [Microsoft Defender Portal](https://security.microsoft.com/): Security portal for threat protection, alerts, and Microsoft 365 security operations.
- [Microsoft Purview Portal](https://compliance.microsoft.com/): Compliance portal for data governance, retention, and regulatory workflows.
- [Microsoft 365 Security Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/security/): Documentation for securing Microsoft 365 identities, apps, and data.
- [Microsoft Purview Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/): Documentation for compliance, governance, and information protection solutions.
- [Microsoft Entra Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/): Identity and access management documentation for Microsoft cloud services.
- [Secure Score](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/security/defender/microsoft-secure-score): Guidance for using Secure Score to improve organizational security posture.

## Adoption and Productivity Guidance
- [Microsoft 365 Adoption](https://adoption.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/): Adoption resources for rollout, change management, and user enablement.
- [Productivity Library](https://adoption.microsoft.com/productivity-library/): Templates and scenarios for improving productivity with Microsoft 365.
- [Microsoft 365 Scenario Library](https://adoption.microsoft.com/en-us/scenario-library/): Business scenario guidance for collaboration, communication, and hybrid work.
- [Microsoft 365 Learning Pathways](https://adoption.microsoft.com/en-us/custom-learning/): Customizable learning solution for training users on Microsoft 365.
- [Copilot Adoption Resources](https://adoption.microsoft.com/copilot/): Adoption guidance and resources for Microsoft Copilot in Microsoft 365.

## News and Product Updates

- [Microsoft 365 Roadmap](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/roadmap): Public roadmap for upcoming Microsoft 365 features and releases.
- [Microsoft Tech Community](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/): Community hub for product discussions, announcements, and technical guidance.
